topic: Divergence and Curl: Understanding Vector Fields

sections.title: Introduction: The Concept of a Vector Field
lecture_lines: Vector fields assign vectors to space points.
Think of fluid flow velocity vectors.
Each point has magnitude and direction.
animations: Display title 'Introduction: The Concept of a Vector Field' in #FFFFFF.
Fade in a grid of static arrows in #AAAAAA.
Show moving particles flowing through the grid in #00FFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/particles.svg].
Fade out static arrows, keep particles flowing using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/fluid.svg].

sections.title: Divergence: Source vs. Sink
lecture_lines: Divergence measures expansion at a point.
Positive divergence acts like a source.
Negative divergence acts like a sink.
animations: Display title 'Divergence: Source vs. Sink' in #FFFFFF.
Show particles moving away from a central point representing a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/faucet.svg] in #FF0000.
Show particles moving towards a central point representing a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drain.svg] in #0000FF.

sections.title: Curl: The Rotation Measure
lecture_lines: Curl measures rotation around a point.
Think of a small spinning pinwheel.
Circulation is non-zero in swirling fields.
animations: Display title 'Curl: The Rotation Measure' in #FFFFFF.
Show particles rotating around a central point in #00FF00, using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pinwheel.svg] to represent the rotation.
Highlight the rotation speed using a circular arrow in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Summary and Real-world Application
lecture_lines: Divergence is expansion; curl is rotation.
